name: China USDT
description: China Dollar Token (CHUSDT) is a BEP-20 digital asset developed on BNB Smart Chain, designed to facilitate cross-border transactions and commercial payments between Iran and China. The project aims to support merchants, importers, exporters, tourists, and international students by enabling digital payments for goods, services, travel, education, and everyday purchases. CHUSDT focuses on accessible, efficient, and transparent blockchain-based transactions.
